name: Go on your FIRST DATE with your BEST FRIEND and try not to panic?!
source:
Play as Harper Hills (she/her), an anxious, awkward, autistic woman who is going on a date at an old diner with one of her childhood best friends, Nathan Bates (he/him), who also just so happens to be anxious, awkward and autistic. Manage her anxiety levels through dialogue choices and, as the title suggests, TRY NOT TO PANIC?!!

[From [url=https://aliilasworld.itch.io/goyfdwybfatntp]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演Harper Hills（她/她），一位焦虑、尴尬、患有自闭症的女性，她正在一家老餐馆与她儿时最好的朋友Nathan Bates（他/他）约会，而Nathan Bates（他/他）也恰好患有焦虑、尴尬和自闭症。通过对话选择来控制她的焦虑水平，正如标题所示，尽量不要惊慌？！！

[来自[url=https://aliilasworld.itch.io/goyfdwybfatntp]itch.io[/url]]
